findings.mitigation: All features trailing/causal; breakout uses shift(1) prior high/low; kernel enforces one completed-bar latency.
ML standardisation fits mu/sd on the training window only; feature z-scores are trailing.
Walk-forward training excludes bars within horizon+purge+embargo of the prediction bar.
Signal at close t fills no earlier than open t+1; no synthetic fills.
Long enters ask/exits bid; short enters bid/exits ask; golden tested.
Actual spread paid in fills + 0.10 bps/fill commission-slippage + 1.5x/2.0x stress; monotone stress tested.
All session logic in America/New_York via tz-aware timestamps; rollover/flat windows golden tested.
Denominator = admitted executable count, frozen pre-outcome; rejected specs never evaluated; not reduced after seeing losses.
V2 specs frozen and hashed before holdout access; firewall blocks 2018+ reads structurally.
Tick capabilities UNSUPPORTED; volume field never read; tick variants rejected pre-outcome.
Only deterministic model classes admitted (quantile bins, fixed-seed GMM, liblinear logistic, closed-form ridge); RF/GBT/NN/HMM rejected.
Provenance is repository-relative; hash chain per trial; clean-room re-materialization byte-identical.
ML/regime insufficient-data blocks abstain (signal 0) rather than guessing; failure_behavior is explicit in the spec.
Frozen survivor predicate separate from informational review ranking; negative-net never a survivor.
